verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents a public HTTP API (POST /v2/query) with an OpenAPI spec, SDKs in four languages sharing the same operation-tree contract, an llms.txt for AI discoverability, and an MCP server exposing query/admin tools — all clearly aimed at AI-native, agentic consumption. Community feedback raises concerns about the bespoke HelixQL query language being less LLM-friendly than something like Cypher, which is a real caveat but doesn't contradict that the API itself is documented and usable. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that LLMs reliably generate correct HelixQL queries against this API, and more evidence of production-scale API robustness beyond docs.
